name: SWI Group (SWI Capital Holding)
note: SWI Capital Holding Ltd, a Singapore holding company, listed on Euronext Amsterdam (SWICH) from 19 February 2026. Its prospectus (16 Feb 2026): Max-Hervé George ultimately holds 95.242% of the voting rights; the group holds 80.26% of Stoneweg S.A. (fully diluted) since October 2025.
